description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Sales/StopOrderLine. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST stop order line operation in sales/order operations. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the stop order line operation for sales/order operations. Input: [FromBody] rq: LoadAddressesFromOrderLineRequest. Main fields: OrderLineIds: int[]. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the stop order line operation. Search terms: sales stoporderline. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
